tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: Sim, tenho ido duas vezes por semana.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Como tens dormido ultimamente?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Is it something repeated or continuing up to now (ultimamente, este mês, nos últimos tempos)? Then use ter + participle: tenho dormido. Is it one single event, even today (hoje, ontem, no ano passado)? Then use the perfeito simples: dormi. Careful: tenho dormido is not the Spanish he dormido. A tile in brackets such as (eu) says who is meant; you don’t write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Tenho ido: repete-se, continua. Fui: aconteceu uma vez.
